name: Hallowed Sigil
summary: In Shadowglen, the Hallowed Sigil summons young night elf initiates to Aldrassil. Shanda sends it to call them into service to Elune.

sections.title: A Summons to the Priesthood
sections.body: Young night elf priests in Shadowglen receive the Hallowed Sigil from a woodland messenger. Holy markings are engraved on the token, which carries a personal summons from Shanda, the priest trainer at Aldrassil. Read it, then go up to the great hollow of Aldrassil. There, the summons brings the acolyte to the Sisterhood of Elune and begins their service to the Kaldorei as new travelers arrive across Teldrassil.

faq.answer: The Hallowed Sigil is an inscribed holy token given to young night elf priests in Shadowglen. Its summons tells the initiate to seek Shanda, their mentor.
A woodland messenger carries the Hallowed Sigil on behalf of Shanda, the priest trainer inside Aldrassil.

faq.q: Where should I take the sigil?
aliases: where do i bring hallowed sigil
faq.answer: Take the sigil to Shanda inside Aldrassil, at the heart of Shadowglen in Teldrassil. Read it, then present the token to her to make your first introduction to your priesthood mentors.

angles.text: As a night elf priest, you receive the Hallowed Sigil as your first summons into formal training under the Sisterhood of Elune.
As a Kaldorei devotee, the sigil marks the beginning of your service, as Alliance travelers begin arriving on Teldrassil's boughs.
